words.definition: n. 睫毛；鞭打 v. 鞭打；抨击；（情绪）迸发

examples.en: She has long dark lashes.
examples.zh: 她有着又长又黑的睫毛。

examples.en: The opposition lashed out at the government's new policy.
examples.zh: 反对党猛烈抨击政府的新政策。

words.usage: eyelash 睫毛常省略为 lash；lash out at/against（猛烈抨击）高频；lash down（捆牢）；whip（鞭子）近义。lashing 痛骂。
collocations: lash out at 猛烈抨击
words.mnemonic: 鞭子一甩 lasha → 鞭打；睫毛

words.definition: n. 骚扰，侵扰

examples.en: She filed a complaint about sexual harassment at work.
examples.zh: 她就工作场所的性骚扰提出投诉。

examples.en: The report documented police harassment of journalists.
examples.zh: 报告记录了警察对记者的骚扰。

words.usage: sexual/racial harassment（性骚扰/种族骚扰）社会高频；harass v. 骚扰（重音英美有别）；零容忍政策 zero tolerance for harassment。
collocations: file a harassment complaint 提交骚扰投诉
words.mnemonic: harass(骚扰)+ment → 骚扰行为

words.definition: adj. 垂直的，竖直的 n. 垂直线

examples.en: The cliff is almost vertical.
examples.zh: 这处悬崖近乎垂直。

examples.en: Draw a vertical line down the centre of the page.
examples.zh: 沿页面中央画一条竖线。

words.usage: vertical line/axis（竖线/竖轴）与 horizontal（水平的）配对高频；vert（转）→ 顶点转向天 → 垂直；vertical market（垂直市场）商科。
words.mnemonic: vertex（顶点）向上 → 垂直

words.definition: adj. 手工的，体力的 n. 使用手册

examples.en: The factory still relies on manual labour.
examples.zh: 工厂仍依赖手工劳动。

examples.en: Read the user manual before installation.
examples.zh: 安装前请阅读用户手册。

words.usage: manual labour/work（体力劳动）高频；user/instruction manual（用户/使用手册）；manually adv. 手动地；manu（手）同根：manufacture、manuscript。
words.mnemonic: manu(手)+al → 手上的活 → 手工；手册

words.definition: n. 可能性，几率；不利条件；（比赛）让步

examples.en: The odds of winning the lottery are very low.
examples.zh: 中彩票的几率非常低。

examples.en: Against all odds, she recovered completely.
examples.zh: 尽管困难重重，她还是完全康复了。

words.usage: 复数形式；the odds are that…（很可能）；against all odds（尽管困难重重）高频习语；odds and ends（零碎物品）；at odds with（与…不和，有分歧）高频。

confusables.note: odd 奇怪的·奇数的，单数

collocations: against all odds 尽管困难重重
odds and ends 零碎东西
words.mnemonic: odd（奇数）加 s → 让步差值 → 几率

words.definition: v. 解开，打开；取消，撤销

examples.en: He undid his shoelaces and sat down.
examples.zh: 他解开鞋带坐了下来。

examples.en: Press Ctrl+Z to undo the last action.
examples.zh: 按 Ctrl+Z 撤销上一步操作。

words.usage: undo the buttons/knot（解开扣子/绳结）；undo the harm/damage（消除危害）比喻高频；what's done cannot be undone（覆水难收）；名词 undoing（毁灭根源）。

confusables.note: redo 重做，re- 反向前缀

collocations: undo the knot 解开绳结
undo the damage 消除损害
words.mnemonic: un(反)+do(做)→ 反做 → 解开；撤销

words.definition: n. 秘书；部长，大臣；（学会）书记

examples.en: She works as a secretary to the managing director.
examples.zh: 她担任总经理的秘书。

examples.en: The Secretary of State will visit China next month.
examples.zh: 国务卿下月将访问中国。

words.usage: secretary to sb（某人的秘书）；Secretary of State（国务卿/国务大臣）大写头衔；secretariat 秘书处；secretarial adj. 秘书的（secretarial skills）。
collocations: secretary to the boss 老板的秘书
words.mnemonic: secret（机密）+ary → 接触机密的人 → 秘书

words.definition: n. 女英雄；女主角

examples.en: The heroine of the novel saves her village from famine.
examples.zh: 小说的女主人公把村庄从饥荒中拯救出来。

examples.en: She became a national heroine after the rescue.
examples.zh: 救援之后她成了民族女英雄。

words.usage: hero（男英雄）+ -ine（阴性后缀）；注意与 heroin（海洛因）音近义远！female hero 也渐用；heroic adj. 英雄的。
collocations: the heroine of the novel 小说女主角
words.mnemonic: hero+ine（女）→ 女英雄

words.definition: n. 印章，封条；海豹 v. 封，密封；确定

examples.en: The envelope was sealed with wax.
examples.zh: 信封用火漆封口。

examples.en: The two countries sealed the deal with a trade agreement.
examples.zh: 两国以贸易协定敲定了这笔交易。

words.usage: seal an envelope/a deal（封口/成交）双义高频；my lips are sealed（我守口如瓶）；seal of approval（官方认可）；seals（海豹）复数同形。
collocations: seal the deal 达成交易
seal of approval 正式认可
words.mnemonic: 盖印即封 → 印章；封口；海豹

words.definition: n. 面纱；遮盖物 v. 蒙面纱；掩饰

examples.en: The bride lifted her veil.
examples.zh: 新娘掀起了面纱。

examples.en: The city lay under a thin veil of morning mist.
examples.zh: 城市笼罩在晨雾的薄纱之中。

words.usage: draw a veil over（把…掩盖过去，不再提）高频习语；under the veil of（在…的幌子下）；unveil v. 揭幕，公布。与 veil 同音 veil/vale 罕混。
collocations: lift the veil 掀起面纱
draw a veil over 掩盖过去
veil of mist 薄雾遮罩
words.mnemonic: 纱一遮，看不清 → 面纱；掩饰

words.definition: adj. 极重要的，必要的 n. 必要的事；祈使语气

examples.en: It is imperative that we act now.
examples.zh: 我们当务之急是立刻行动。

examples.en: Survival is the first imperative of any species.
examples.zh: 生存是任何物种的头等要务。

words.usage: it is imperative that +（should）do 虚拟语气高频写作句型；grammar 义祈使语气（imperative mood）；empire 同根（imper 统治）→ 命令性的。
words.mnemonic: imper(命令)+ative → 命令式的 → 必须的

words.definition: n. 行人 adj. 平淡无奇的

examples.en: Pedestrians should cross at the zebra crossing.
examples.zh: 行人应走斑马线过马路。

examples.en: The novel has a rather pedestrian plot.
examples.zh: 这部小说情节相当平淡。

words.usage: pedestrian crossing（人行横道）交通高频；ped（脚）→ 步行者；形容词贬义「平庸的」：a pedestrian style（平淡的风格）。pedal、pedlar 同根族。

confusables.note: pediatrician 儿科医生，ped- 同头

words.mnemonic: ped(脚)走路的人 → 行人；平庸

words.definition: n. 灯笼，提灯

examples.en: Red lanterns were hung along the street for the festival.
examples.zh: 为庆祝节日，街上挂满了红灯笼。

examples.en: The old man carried a storm lantern into the cave.
examples.zh: 老人提着防风灯走进山洞。

words.usage: Chinese lantern（灯笼）；lantern festival（灯节）；magic lantern（早期幻灯机）；the Lantern Festival 元宵节大写。与 lamp（台灯）、light（灯，总称）辨析。
words.mnemonic: lan+tern 提着透光的罩 → 灯笼

words.definition: n. 激光；激光器

examples.en: The surgeon used a laser to remove the tumour.
examples.zh: 外科医生用激光切除了肿瘤。

examples.en: Laser technology is used in data storage.
examples.zh: 激光技术被用于数据存储。

words.usage: 缩略词：Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation；laser surgery/printer/beam（激光手术/打印机/束）高频；动词激光照射。
words.mnemonic: 首字母缩略词 → 激光

words.definition: n. 侦察员；球探；童子军 v. 侦察；物色

examples.en: The scout reported enemy movements to headquarters.
examples.zh: 侦察员向司令部报告了敌人的动向。

examples.en: Talent scouts are watching tonight's match.
examples.zh: 球探们在观看今晚的比赛。

words.usage: scout around/for（四处寻找，物色）高频；Boy/Girl Scout（童子军）；talent scout 星探；scouting trip 考察之行。
words.mnemonic: scout 出去探路 → 侦察；物色

words.definition: n. 硬件；五金制品；（军事）装备

examples.en: The computer's hardware needs upgrading.
examples.zh: 这台电脑的硬件需要升级。

examples.en: You can buy tools at the hardware store.
examples.zh: 你可以在五金店买工具。

words.usage: computer hardware/software（硬件/软件）IT 高频；hardware store/shop（五金店）；military hardware（军事装备）新闻高频。与 ware（器皿）词基。
words.mnemonic: hard(硬)+ware(器件)→ 硬件；五金

words.definition: v. 抓住；夺取，没收；把握

examples.en: He seized her arm and pulled her back.
examples.zh: 他一把抓住她的手臂把她拉回来。

examples.en: Police seized a large quantity of illegal drugs.
examples.zh: 警方查获了大量毒品。

words.usage: seize the opportunity/chance（抓住机会）高频；seize power/control（夺取政权/控制权）；siege（围困）同源；与 cease（停止）同音必辨！
collocations: seize the opportunity 抓住机会
words.mnemonic: 一把抓住（ seize）不放

words.definition: n. 部分，段，瓣 v. 分割

examples.en: The orange is divided into eight segments.
examples.zh: 这个橙子分成了八瓣。

examples.en: The company targets the luxury segment of the market.
examples.zh: 该公司瞄准市场的高端细分领域。

words.usage: market segment（细分市场）商科高频；line segment（线段）数学；segmentation n. 细分；sect（切）同根 section、sector。
collocations: segment the market 细分市场
words.mnemonic: sect(切)+ment → 切下的一段

words.definition: v. 抓，挠；划破 n. 抓痕；起跑线

examples.en: The cat scratched the sofa badly.
examples.zh: 猫把沙发抓坏了。

examples.en: He started his business from scratch.
examples.zh: 他从零开始创业。

words.usage: from scratch（从零开始）高频习语；scratch the surface（浅尝辄止）；scratch one's head（挠头；困惑）；up to scratch（达标）。
collocations: scratch the surface 浅尝辄止
words.mnemonic: scr 挠出声 → 抓；划痕

words.definition: prep. 对，对抗；（对比）与…相对

examples.en: The match is China versus Japan.
examples.zh: 这场比赛是中国队对日本队。

examples.en: The debate centres on freedom versus security.
examples.zh: 辩论围绕自由与安全之争。

words.usage: 缩写 vs. / v.；体育比分 China vs Japan；法律案名（Roe v. Wade）；抽象对比 freedom versus control 高频写作；拉丁「转向」→ 面对面。
collocations: quality versus quantity 质与量之比
freedom versus security 自由与安全之争
words.mnemonic: vers(转)彼此 → 对垒
